basics.description:
**ANY.RUN Sandbox for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint** automatically detonates files and URLs from new Defender for Endpoint alerts in the ANY.RUN Interactive Sandbox. The alert is enriched with the verdict, threat score, a link to the analysis and IOCs, and the IOCs are imported as Defender indicators.

The deployment creates a Function App (Flex Consumption), a Logic App with a Defender for Endpoint connection, a dedicated Storage Account and Application Insights in the selected resource group.

Each deployment creates a new instance; all its resources share the instance name. To update an existing instance, enter its instance name on this page.

basics.name: instanceName
basics.label: Instance name
basics.toolTip: Used in the names of all resources of this deployment. Keep the suggested random value to create a new instance, or enter the name of an existing instance to update it. Up to 12 lowercase letters and digits.

constraints.validationMessage: Use up to 12 lowercase letters and digits.

options.text: Resource names use this instance, for example ANYRUN-Sandbox-MDE-<instance>-LA and ANYRUN-Sandbox-MDE-<instance>-<hash>-FA. The suggested random name creates a new instance. To update an existing instance, enter its name (see the Instance tag on its resources). An empty instance name keeps the resource names of version 1.1.1.
Each Sandbox instance subscribes to all new alerts of its Defender tenant. Two instances connected to the same tenant analyze every alert twice unless their Logic Apps use different alert filters.

The selected region has not been confirmed as supporting Azure Functions Flex Consumption. Wait for the region list to load. If this message persists, check Microsoft.Web access or choose another region.

Before you continue: create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID and grant it the WindowsDefenderATP application permissions Alert.ReadWrite.All, Machine.LiveResponse, Machine.ReadWrite.All, Ti.ReadWrite and Library.Manage with admin consent, then create a client secret. Use a dedicated app registration for this connector. Click here for step-by-step instructions.

In the Microsoft Defender portal enable Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features: Live Response, Live Response for Servers and Live Response unsigned script execution. The connector uses Live Response to collect evidence files from devices.

elements.name: tenantId
elements.label: Directory (tenant) ID
elements.toolTip: Tenant ID of the Microsoft Entra directory that contains the app registration.

elements.name: clientId
elements.label: Application (client) ID
elements.toolTip: Application (client) ID of the app registration.

validations.message: Flex Consumption support for the selected region has not been confirmed. Return to Basics and wait for the region list, check Microsoft.Web access, or choose another region.

elements.name: clientSecret
elements.toolTip: Value (not the ID) of the client secret created for the app registration.

constraints.validationMessage: The client secret must be at least 12 characters.

elements.name: indicatorAction
elements.label: Indicator action
elements.toolTip: Action applied to IOCs that ANY.RUN finds and the connector imports as Defender indicators.

elements.name: generateAlert
elements.label: Generate a Defender alert when an imported indicator matches
elements.toolTip: Disabled by default to avoid an alert storm from Audit-mode indicators.

options.text: An ANY.RUN Sandbox API key is required. Contact your ANY.RUN account manager or request a demo to get one.

elements.name: apiKey
elements.toolTip: ANY.RUN API key without the 'API-KEY' prefix.

constraints.validationMessage: The API key must be at least 12 characters.

elements.name: privacyType
elements.label: Analysis visibility
elements.toolTip: Private tasks require an ANY.RUN plan that supports them.

options.text: A by-link analysis is accessible to anyone who obtains its link. Choose this only if your ANY.RUN plan does not support private tasks and your organization accepts this.

elements.name: evidenceContainer
elements.label: Evidence container name
elements.toolTip: Private blob container in the dedicated Storage Account where Live Response uploads evidence files.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; must start and end with a letter or digit.

elements.name: lifecycle
elements.label: Delete evidence after 1 day and job status after 7 days
elements.toolTip: Adds lifecycle rules to the dedicated Storage Account created by this deployment.

elements.name: workspaceMode
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace
elements.toolTip: Application Insights for the Function App stores its data in a Log Analytics workspace.

elements.name: workspace
elements.label: Existing workspace
elements.toolTip: Select an existing Log Analytics workspace.
